content: My first file about smooth representations is now available #41520 It is currently with a draft label because it depends on two smaller PR #41081 #40941, addressing some technical prerequisites, but I believe it is close its final form. Any comments are welcome!

A second file Representation.Smooth.SmRep is now availble in the same PR #41520. It defines the category of smooth representations, endow it with a closed, braided, monoidal structure. It also show sthat the functors ihom and dual is compatible with smoothHom contragredient at the object level.

I have opened an official PR #41525 for Representation.Smooth.Basic. Could someone please help add the t-algebra label?
Edit: Labeled. Thanks!
